C1754.title: LLM02:2023 Data Leakage Risk Definition and Example Scenarios
C1754.summary: OWASP defines data leakage in the LLM Application Top 10 as a vulnerability where large language models inadvertently expose sensitive information, proprietary algorithms, or other confidential details through their responses.
